name: Mosaic Manufacturing
summary: Canadian 3D-printing hardware company, launched in 2015 on Kickstarter as a Montreal startup, known for the Palette multi-material splicers and now focused on industrial and orthotics/prosthetics printing (Array, Element, Orion). It sells 'Mosaic Materials' PLA, ABS and ASA tuned for Palette splicing; the filament manufacturer is not disclosed.

product_lines.name: Aero / Align (O&P materials)
product_lines.notes: Materials for orthotics and prosthetics on the Orion printer; chemistry not documented in the notes.

additional_notes: Primarily a hardware company; filament is a secondary product line. The filament OEM is not disclosed. Contract extrusion is plausible, but there is no evidence either way, so oem_relationships is empty. colorFabb's mention of Mosaic is Palette compatibility only. Premium pricing is suggested but unverified, so price_tier is omitted. SpoolmanDB PR #403 lists 3 entries.

provenance.conflicts: City unresolved: 2015 coverage calls it a Montreal startup, and Hamilton was suggested but not verified. Filament manufacturer and origin unknown (low confidence).
